description: Make another person the owner of an account (mailbox, calendar, meeting or file account, bridge). The new owner gets full access; the previous owner loses it unless keep_previous_owner is read/write/manage. Runners cannot be transferred (they belong to the person they run as). Tenant admin only.

keep_previous_owner.description: Access the previous owner keeps; none removes it

resource_type.description: Type of the account to transfer

name: transfer_account_owner
